description: SEL cable / hybrid bolt element object (created by 'sel hybrid create').
note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.sel.cable module functions. 3DEC 7.0-only module: the legacy SEL (structural element) scripting interface. Absent from 3DEC 9.x, where structural elements are accessed through itasca.structure instead. All signatures and descriptions were captured from live 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161) __doc__ introspection.

methods.name: area
methods.description: Get the cross-section area of a hybrid bolt.

methods.name: collection
methods.description: Get the collection ID for this hybrid bolt element.

methods.name: dir
methods.description: Get the cable hybrid bolt direction (vector).

methods.name: dir_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the cable hybrid bolt direction.

methods.name: dir_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the cable hybrid bolt direction.

methods.name: dir_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the cable hybrid bolt direction.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the cable extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: force_axial
methods.description: Get the axial force in the hybrid bolt element (tension negative).

methods.name: force_thermal
methods.description: Get the axial thermal force in the hybrid bolt element (tension negative).

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the cable group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: cable.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the cable. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this cable is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: grout_cohesion
methods.description: Get the grout cohesion.

methods.name: grout_friction
methods.description: Get the grout internal friction angle in degrees.

methods.name: grout_perimeter
methods.description: Get the grout exposed perimeter.

methods.name: grout_stiffness
methods.description: Get the grout stiffness (units of force / displacement).

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the cable id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: cable.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the cable is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Get the index (offset) on the hybrid bolt element.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Get the length of the hybrid bolt element.

methods.name: matnum
methods.description: Get the hybrid bolt material property number for this hybrid bolt element.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Get a node from a hybrid bolt, given a node number (1 first node; 2 = second node).

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the cable hybrid bolt position (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the cable hybrid bolt position.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the cable hybrid bolt position.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the cable hybrid bolt position.

methods.name: rupture_tension
methods.description: Get the limit axial strain for rupture in tension.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the cable extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: cable.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the cable group name in a given slot.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Get the failure state indicator for a hybrid bolt element (0 = elastic, 1 = tensile yield, 2 = compressive yield, 3 = axial rupture).

methods.name: strain_axial
methods.description: Get the axial strain of the hybrid bolt element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

methods.name: stress_axial
methods.description: Get the axial stress of the hybrid bolt element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this cable is live.

methods.name: yield_compression
methods.description: Get the compression yield strength of the hybrid bolt element.

methods.name: yield_tension
methods.description: et the tension yield strength of the hybrid bolt (units of force).

methods.name: young
methods.description: Get the Young's modulus of the hybrid bolt.
